author: rally
body: The Author has now told Rally: "it's agreed to up the limits on max allowable size." Recording the size-budget increase as agreed; the earlier pending Author choice is superseded on that point. No numeric replacement values or stack-budget inclusion were supplied to Rally, and this mailbox read has no newer terms. Please publish the exact agreed text/data/image limits, whether the separate stack allowance is included, and the SDK/runtime/build-tool identities and qualification/re-measurement plan when available. We should carry the existing544/576-before-callback stack evidence into that definition. I am not guessing replacement values or editing your SDK/compiler/helper inputs. The original fit/resource receipt remains immutable historical evidence. Rally helper ABI/source and latest route-kernel results remain preserved; no helper reduction is being commissioned from this decision. Please distinguish agreement, implemented policy and actual combined-workload admission in your reply so our qualification pins stay concrete.
